title: Analytic: oblique Fresnel transmission and Brewster angle (Bloch FDTD)
description:
A plane-wave pulse hits a vacuum / glass interface (n = 1.5) at oblique incidence, once in E_z (physics 'em_s', s-polarised) and once in H_z (physics 'em_p', p-polarised). The strip is y-periodic with Bloch wave vector ky = 2 pi sin(theta) / lambda0, so the vertical line source launches the wave at angle theta at lambda0 = 1 um; the sweep runs theta over 0-60 deg and the Brewster angle atan(1.5) = 56.31 deg.
Analytic (Fresnel): r_s = (cos_i - n cos_t) / (cos_i + n cos_t), r_p = (n cos_i - cos_t) / (n cos_i + cos_t), T = 1 - r^2; incident power per period P_s = A^2 Ly / (2 eta0 cos_i) (an E_z sheet radiates A / cos_i), P_p = A^2 Ly cos_i / (2 eta0) (an in-plane sheet radiates |E| = A).
Sweep tab: derived T_s, T_p (power_per_cw of the glass flux line at lambda0 / P) vs theta_deg with the dashed Fresnel references; R_p_excess = (1 - T_p) - r_p^2 against 0, an absolute reflectance error (r_p^2 goes to 0 at the Brewster angle, so a relative error of R_p is meaningless there).
Spectra tab: at fixed ky the angle changes with wavelength, sin(theta) = ky lambda / (2 pi). Select em_p.trans with reference em_s.trans: the ratio plot shows P_p / P_s against the dashed cos_i^2 T_p / T_s curve (last sweep value, 60 deg).
Expected agreement: ~1 % absolute in T (discrete dispersion at 66 cells per glass wavelength, CPML reflection of oblique waves, truncated ring-down near the grazing cutoff 2 pi / ky).

parameters.name: n_glass
parameters.description: refractive index of the glass half space

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: source centre wavelength = wavelength of the derived values

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length (cpml on both x faces)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (10 cells; only the zeroth diffraction order)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: line source x (cell centre), in vacuum

parameters.name: x_glass
parameters.description: vacuum / glass interface (glass fills x >= x_glass into the PML)

parameters.name: x_flux
parameters.description: transmitted flux line x (cell centre), in the glass

parameters.name: bw
parameters.description: relative pulse bandwidth: narrow, so the spectrum is negligible at the grazing cutoff 2 pi / ky (1.155 um at 60 deg)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (pulse 2 t0 ~ 190 fs plus transit)

parameters.name: P_s
parameters.description: incident E_z power per period [W/m] toward +x

parameters.name: P_p
parameters.description: incident H_z power per period [W/m] toward +x
